scope.note: Phase B source-wide adapters and Phase C HLA/HLB runtime/prediction contracts are accepted. The first-wave learning protocol for Tasks 11, 14 and 19 is frozen, but execution remains unauthorized pending baseline implementation, four-shard preflight, measured resource budget, generated-confirmatory protocol and explicit authorization.

source.archive_tarball_status: not acquired; selected experiment members are frozen individually

selected_member_source.verification: member byte size and Git blob SHA-1 pinned; SHA-256 recorded in Phase Q source freeze manifest

source.source_format: UTF-8 numbered story lines; story reset at line number 1; question lines contain tab-separated question, answer, and supporting-fact line numbers.
source.official_validation_configuration: en-valid-10k is a distinct release configuration; its task files were not present in the pinned external mirror commit used for the six-member freeze.
source.project_validation_policy: Derive deterministic 90/10 fit/validation partitions from each task's en-10k training stories at whole-story granularity. Keep official en-10k test bytes quarantined and parse them label-free.
source.split_policy: Task-specific deterministic hash ranking; preserve source story order within each partition; no story may cross partitions.

shared_contract.unknown_or_ambiguous_reference_policy: explicit abstention plus diagnostic; never guess or silently bind
shared_contract.support_witness_policy: preserve exact official support-line IDs; distinguish official annotated supports from learner-retrieved evidence
shared_contract.generated_confirmatory: task-specific generator with fixed seed, novel entities/topologies/times, label-free inputs, separate evaluator labels; not described as official test data
shared_contract.parity: HLA and HLB receive byte-identical task inputs, order, seeds, horizons and task-specific encodings

tasks.name: Basic Coreference
tasks.input_shape: Numbered story statements plus location/state questions. Statements include singular antecedent mentions and pronominal references (e.g. he/she/it in source variants); question asks for an entity's current location/state. Question line: <line_no> <question>\t<answer>\t<support_line_numbers>.
tasks.answer_shape: Single entity/location token or phrase as tab field 2; support line numbers as whitespace-separated integers in tab field 3.

evidence.L0: Observed sentence/event features, mention surface form, grammatical number/person, source time and current-state feature vector.
evidence.L1: Entity-mention nodes and typed COREFERS_TO / MENTION_OF links; antecedent candidate set, resolved identity edge and provenance to mention lines.
evidence.L2: Entity-level current-state context and persistent mention-chain summary; no gold antecedent injected.

risks: pronoun scope limited to source grammar
coreference correctness must be separated from downstream location accuracy

tasks.name: Time Reasoning
tasks.input_shape: Numbered narrative statements containing absolute/relative temporal expressions (e.g. yesterday, afternoon, this evening) and event/location assertions. Questions ask where an entity went before/after a referenced event or where it was at a temporal point. Question line: <line_no> <question>\t<answer>\t<support_line_numbers>.
tasks.answer_shape: Single location/event answer phrase in tab field 2; supporting source line numbers in tab field 3.

evidence.L0: Observed event and temporal-expression features, normalized time anchor where derivable, source order and observation time kept distinct.
evidence.L1: Typed event nodes and BEFORE / AFTER / SAME_TIME / TEMPORALLY_ANCHORED_TO relations with exact source witnesses.
evidence.L2: Ordered temporal context, event-time index and persistent summary sufficient to answer relative-time queries.

risks: event time is not observation time
ambiguous/incomparable time expressions must not be forced into a total order

tasks.name: Path Finding
tasks.input_shape: Numbered statements encode relative-position facts in the form 'The X is north/south/east/west of the Y.' Questions request a route between two locations; answer is an ordered comma-separated sequence of one-letter direction codes in tab field 2.
tasks.answer_shape: Comma-separated cardinal-direction codes (n/s/e/w) in tab field 2, mapped to north/south/east/west; preserve token order exactly. Supporting relation-line numbers are in tab field 3.

evidence.L0: Observed directed edge features, endpoint identities, orientation and source order.
evidence.L1: Typed directed spatial edges with explicit inverse orientation and source witnesses; composition retains ordered intermediate edges.
evidence.L2: Ordered route/path state with intermediate nodes and witness chain; endpoint reachability alone is insufficient.

baseline_requirements: shortest-path oracle upper bound clearly labelled
risks: direction convention must be fixed and tested
route answer is an ordered token sequence
multiple paths/ambiguity require benchmark-specific deterministic policy
no invented edge or unobserved shortcut

tasks.name: Compound Coreference
tasks.input_shape: Statements include compound subjects (multiple named entities) and plural pronouns referring to the compound set; questions ask for an individual entity's resulting state/location. Same numbered/tab-separated bAbI record format.
tasks.answer_shape: Single location/state answer phrase plus supporting line-number list.

evidence.L0: Mention features including plurality, conjunction membership and plural pronoun features.
evidence.L1: Entity-set nodes, member-of edges and plural COREFERS_TO links with set-valued antecedents.
evidence.L2: Persistent group/entity state with membership-sensitive updates and disambiguation.

risks: plural pronoun must bind to a set, not a single entity
group updates must not overwrite non-members

tasks.name: Two Supporting Facts
tasks.input_shape: Numbered stories and tab-separated question, answer, support-line list; queries require composition of two supporting facts.
tasks.answer_shape: Single answer token/phrase and support line numbers.

evidence.L0: Observed facts and entity/object state features.
evidence.L1: Typed binary relations with explicit two-edge support chain.
evidence.L2: Query context and two-hop composed evidence summary.

risks: must not conflate support count with unique relation count

tasks.name: Two Argument Relations
tasks.input_shape: Numbered statements encode directed binary relations (commonly spatial direction); questions query a relation or its inverse. Tab-separated answer and support-line fields.
tasks.answer_shape: Single direction/relation token or phrase and support line numbers.

evidence.L1: Directed binary relation edge with explicit inverse semantics.
evidence.L2: Relation-query context and compact relational state.

risks: directional inverse must be explicit; do not infer transitive closure unless separately contracted

campaign.candidate_selection: task-specific validation only; no pooled cross-task ranking
campaign.confirmatory: separate per-task fixed-seed generated challenge after task-specific candidate freeze
campaign.execution_gate: Protocol frozen only. No execution until task-specific baselines, nested warm-start/online partitioning, four-shard failure/retry/evidence preflight, measured workload budgets, generated-confirmatory protocol and explicit authorization are reviewed.

implementation.input_label_separation: ExpansionStory/ExpansionQuery contain no gold answers or support IDs; GoldLabel is a separate evaluator-only stream.
implementation.task11: Singular she/he coreference uses explicit entity mentions, a constrained source-name gender prior and nearest compatible antecedent. Unresolved pronouns fail closed.
implementation.task14: Temporal event time (yesterday/morning/afternoon/evening plus source order) is distinct from observed_at; before-location oracle chooses the previous location before the requested destination event.
implementation.task19: Relative-position statements create directed edges plus explicit inverses; BFS composes ordered direction codes; ambiguous shortest direction sequences abstain.
implementation.partitioning: Deterministic 90/10 whole-story split from en-10k train; test is parsed with include_labels=False and never emitted as learner input.
